svg.font-family: Virgil, 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive
svg.title: Belayed agents: the agent climbs lot by lot in a harness, the operator holds the rope, each anchor is a guardrail
svg.desc: Hand-drawn sketch. A climber (the coding agent) wearing a red climbing harness goes up a wall whose holds are lots. The rope runs from the harness through anchors named intent, tests, review and CI, down to a belayer on the ground (the operator and the orchestrator). The summit flag reads shipped; the repository at the foot of the wall holds the state.
svg.text: disposable, one lot at a time
clipped in before the first move
holds the rope, decides, never climbs for the agent
the rope: slack to move, tight on a slip
Agents write the code. The harness is intent, tests, review and CI:
a slip costs one anchor, not the whole route.
